cli.help:
Arcana World — Bilibili live console / Bubble Tea

Usage: arcana-world [options]

Explicit proxy, OBS auto-connect/auto-stream and TTS overrides apply only to this run, are not saved, and cannot be changed in the interface.

Drag within chat, history, log, or notification body text to select; y copies, Esc clears. Ctrl+C opens quit confirmation.

On Chat, press u or click Viewers, or g or Fleet, to view the corresponding list. Each shows up to 20 users; r refreshes and Esc returns.

Click a chat speaker's name to see their avatar, name, fan medal and UID. Actions: mute for a chosen number of hours or permanently, add to the room blocklist, appoint as moderator, or open their profile. The first three require confirmation. Dragging a name still selects text without opening the popup.

On Chat, m manages moderators, b the blocklist, and s the mute list; you can also click the header controls. Enter a positive whole number of hours or choose Permanent, then confirm. Blocking removes relationships and restricts chat, gifts, and other interactions.
